asset.name: EditorField
asset.description: The lazily loaded rich text, Markdown, code, or JSON editing field selected through an adapter while sharing labels, errors, loading treatment, autosave, and form integration.

requires.reason: Label, description, and error relationships are shared.

rationale: Explicitly lazy: editor implementations are the largest single thing that can end up in a base bundle, and the adapter boundary is what keeps them out of it.
